pr_title: Fix for ecobee unknown sensor state
pr_body:
## Description:

The sensor platform was not catching all possible return values from the ecobee API for processing, resulting in the issue which this PR fixes. Now also catch the returned value "unknown". Also rewrote the async_update method to add guard clauses for greater efficiency in returning the state value.

Should be considered for a point release.

**Related issue (if applicable):** fixes #27489 

**Pull request with documentation for [home-assistant.io](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io) (if applicable):** N/A

**Home Assistant release with the issue:**

0.100.1

**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**

0.99

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**

Docker

**Integration:**
<!--

**Description of problem:**

With Ecobee in version 0.100.1 I am seeing many errors which seem to be a string being forced to a float.

**Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` entries and (fill out even if it seems unimportant):**
```yaml
N/A - now an integration 
```

**Traceback (if applicable):**
```
Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 408, in _async_add_entity
    await entity.async_update_ha_state()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 273, in async_update_ha_state
    self._async_write_ha_state()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 307, in _async_write_ha_state
    state = self.state
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/ecobee/sensor.py", line 81, in state
    return float(self._state) / 10
ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'unknown'
```

**Additional information:**

Generally Ecobee seems to work but I have over 3300 events of the above in my logs, all the same.  The message over being line 81 seems odd as the source doesn't match that, but I do see this later in the file around ~120.
comments: I will take a look! Not sure where the ‘unknown’ is coming from.

Very strange to me that your temperature sensor is returning the value 'unknown' - the API is supposed to return -5002 when a value is unknown, not the string 'unknown'. I can fix this but it is still mystifying.

Edit: spoke too soon - buried in the API is a note that an unknown value for a remote sensor is returned as "unknown" - thanks for pointing this out so I can fix.
As an FYI it seems to be caused by a remote sensor with a dead battery.  Must have died very recently, but did not see this error under 0.99.x.

review_comments: Should this become part of PYECOBEE ?
For sure it should. There are a bunch of additions to pyecobee I want to make when the dust has settled on the changes in HA.
